name: The Festival
source:
A YGO high school AU. Ryou is looking forward the school festival, but he'll find out that not nothing is easy when the two class troublemakers, TK and Bakura, are fighting for his attention. Contains tendershipping and gemshipping.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/the-festival]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《游戏王》高中平行世界同人作。獏良期待着校园祭，却发现当两名班级捣蛋鬼TK与獏良争夺他的注意时，一切并不容易。含Tendershipping与Gemshipping配对。

[译自[url=http://renai.us/game/the-festival]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
